risk_note: RV2 (apps/api/src/modules/payout/**, content kill-switch hook / config-item-admin / kill-switch-admin, app.module): automatic-payout config save checks and the enable precheck (BR-WDR-30 / BR-WDR-17 / BR-WDR-22). Save checks run inside config-item-admin's real write paths (single PUT, batch, rollback) under the row locks of the save: max_amount_fen <= withdraw.max_amount_fen, platform_daily_max_fen <= payout.daily_cap_fen in both directions (lowering payout.daily_cap_fen is checked too), window_end > window_start, risk_block_flags only BR-WDR-29 codes; absent keys take the 08 defaults; refusal is 20001 with the field. The enable precheck lives in payout (② ⑤ ⑧ supported flags, default false; reconciliation days >= recon_required_days, unset = not met; recon_passed_days through an injected port defaulting to 0 per D10-392), every item listed, any failure refuses; content/domain/kill-switch.ts only gains an injection hook whose default keeps the unconditional refusal; switching off is never blocked; the owner's confirmation stays (BR-WDR-17). The four config keys and their frozen assertions were landed first as B2-11dz (#1723) and B2-11dzb (#1729) (D10-394 / D10-399 / D10-400). Rule tests by fresh independent Claude runs (approvals #36), three rounds plus the D10-399 deletion of the task's own registry.test.ts; red PASS on the spec commit (116 red, 0 problems). Implementation by an Opus 5.5 subagent in one run, resumed once after the host network dropped (ECONNRESET, not a new round). verify:fast in the test-machine container exit 0. Full verify on the test machine (verify/1): exit 124 at the 3600 s limit with no failing case before it; every auto-config test passed, including save-wiring.int (12), and the config-items integration suites; recorded per D10-319, CI verify-int is the check.
